summary:

Generate a two-character narrative scene video using <Picture 1> and <Picture 2> as character references, and <Picture 3> as the environment reference.

Create a short street scene in which both characters walk together through the city, notice an interesting storefront, exchange two rounds of dialogue naturally, and continue moving forward together.

Maintain strong consistency for both characters and the environment.

detailed_description:

[Shot 1]

<Subject 1> and <Subject 2> are walking together through the street environment as companions.

At the beginning of the scene, both characters move forward naturally along the street.
<Subject 1> walks in a calm and relaxed way.
<Subject 2> walks beside him, observing the surroundings with quiet curiosity.

As they approach the storefront area, <Subject 2> notices something interesting on one side of the street.
She gradually slows down, turns her head slightly toward the nearby shops, and pauses with a curious expression.

First round of dialogue:

<Subject 2> speaks first while looking toward the storefront:

<d>[Chinese] 这里好像比想象中还热闹，你看那边的小店，好像很有意思。</d>

<Subject 1> notices her reaction and also slows down.
He turns slightly toward <Subject 2>, then follows her gaze toward the same storefront.

<Subject 1> replies naturally:

<d>[Chinese] 确实，我们过去看看吧，说不定还能发现新的惊喜。</d>

Second round of dialogue:

After a brief natural pause, <Subject 2> shows a slightly brighter expression and responds:

<d>[Chinese] 好啊，这种地方总让人想慢慢逛一逛，说不定还能找到特别的小东西。</d>

After the dialogue, both characters naturally continue walking forward together, returning to a relaxed pace as if continuing their street exploration.

Use restrained, realistic movement throughout the scene:
- slow natural walking
- slight arm swing
- subtle blinking
- gentle breathing
- small head turns
- light posture adjustments

Maintain natural facial expressions and soft interaction.
Keep the movements controlled and coherent.

Do not use exaggerated gestures.

Do not create extra people.
Keep both character identities fully consistent with their references.
Keep the street environment unchanged and recognizable.


Camera:

Use a stable medium-wide shot that keeps both characters and enough of the street environment clearly visible.

The camera remains mostly fixed with natural observational framing.
No dramatic camera movement.
No fast panning.
No zoom.
No scene transition.


overall_soundscape:

Maintain a natural urban daytime ambience appropriate for a quiet Japanese street.

The spoken lines should feel naturally integrated into the scene.
